calls.title: Polymarket<>GrowthBook - Experimentation Discussion
calls.summary: Polymarket's principal economist Nick Riabov and head of data Kai discussed using GrowthBook for marketplace experimentation at the event/market level (not user-level) due to spillover effects, requiring custom randomization handled externally and GrowthBook as an analysis layer. Pain points included handling high-frequency liquidity data via coarsening and integrating feature flagging for policy rollout. Next step: schedule a follow-up call with GrowthBook and Polymarket engineering to discuss integration with their API.

calls.title: Polymarket<>GrowthBook - Engineering Discussion
calls.summary: Polymarket (Nick Riabov, business/engineering) discussed their need for an experimentation platform, particularly for switchback experiments and backend feature flag integration with their Clickhouse warehouse. GrowthBook (Jake Heier, sales; Bryce Fitzsimons, engineering; Luke Sonnet, science) explained switchback is on the roadmap, demonstrated metric and CUPED capabilities, and outlined push/pull SDK models for secure flag delivery. Next steps: GrowthBook will send relevant documentation; Polymarket will finalize vendor evaluation in 1–1.5 weeks and follow up.

calls.title: Polymarket<>GrowthBook - Onboarding and Implementation Discussion
calls.summary: The call primarily consisted of off-topic banter about recording tools (Apollo vs. Firefly) and data surveillance concerns, with no substantive discussion of the product, features, or pain points. Key participants were Jake Heier (likely from Polymarket), Max “Primo” Mershon, Chris Sanders, and Nick (who joined late). No next steps or action items were identified.
